_doc: INKED 16:9 gravitas-test SLICE for the Psalm-22 long pilot (MOTIONCOMIC_SPEC v1.1, [LONG] provisional). 3 scenes spanning the arc (cry -> messianic wound -> risen land-on-Christ), adapted from the existing Baroque visual_16x9/scene_plan.json (#1, #9, #24). Purpose: judge whether the inked graphic-novel look holds reverent gravitas over a long, via an A/B against the already-rendered Baroque clips (01/09/24 .mp4). Reuses the LOCKED narration.mp3 (audio $0). NOT the full 24-scene plan — that is only built if this slice wins the gravitas A/B.

header.note: slice only samples 3 of 24 scenes for the A/B; page_seconds/full-cost derived only if it proceeds

scenes.concept: the crucified Christ crying out against a vast black noon sky
scenes.prompt_seed: inked biblical graphic-novel, a wide cinematic hero shot: the crucified Christ - a dark-haired bearded man in his early thirties, calm Near-Eastern face - seen close and intimate against a vast black thunderous noon sky, his head tipped back as he cries out with his last strength, robed at the waist, a single shaft of pale light breaking through the storm onto his face and bare shoulders; bold black ink outlines, cel-flat color, dramatic cross-hatched deep shadow, reverent, epic, 1st-century
scenes.why: cold-open hero: does an inked cross-cry carry the same weight as the Baroque plate?

scenes.concept: a nail-pierced hand in sharp focus, 'they pierced my hands and my feet'
scenes.prompt_seed: inked biblical graphic-novel, a wide macro: a nail-pierced hand in sharp focus catching one shaft of light, the hand anatomically correct with five distinct separated fingers and a clearly separate thumb, a single large hand-forged square iron Roman nail driven straight through the centre of the open palm deep into a dark rough wooden beam, dark red blood welling around the iron and running down the wrist; bold black ink outlines, cel-flat color, cross-hatched shadow, reverent, 1st-century
scenes.why: the messianic wound (Ps 22:16 fulfilled) - live crucifixion nail, not a risen scar; tests the wound render at 16:9

scenes.concept: the risen Christ reaching an open pierced hand toward the viewer (the CTA landing)
scenes.prompt_seed: inked biblical graphic-novel, a wide hero close: the risen Christ - a dark-haired bearded man with a serene glorified face - in warm radiant golden light, reaching one open hand gently toward the viewer, a faint thin old scar line across the centre of the palm; bold black ink outlines, cel-flat color, reverent, inviting, 1st-century
scenes.why: land-on-Christ close (MC-G10) + the corrected wound rule MC-R1 (visible healed nail-PRINT, John 20:25-27) - the highest-stakes gravitas test
